answer: DEFINE EncF ::= LIST f, pv, mv FROM Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has Patient has PatientPatkey p AND ALSO has EncounterMissappt m AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p GROUPED BY f AS pv AND ALSO THE SUM OF m GROUPED BY f AS mv DEFINE CriF ::= LIST f, cv FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c AND ALSO THE SUM OF c GROUPED BY f AS cv DEFINE PsmF ::= LIST f, sv FROM EncounterFacid f has CriF CriFCv c AND ALSO has EncF EncFPv p AND ALSO has mv EncFMv m AND ALSO (1.0 / (1.0 + c / p + m / p)) AS sv DEFINE TarF ::= LIST f, av FROM Treatmentoutcome has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS av DEFINE Rk ::= LIST f, ta, sa FROM EncounterFacid f has TarF TarFAv a AND ALSO has PsmF PsmFSv s AND ALSO 1 AS g AND ALSO THE RANK OF a WITHIN g AS ta AND ALSO THE RANK OF s WITHIN g AS sa LIST f, ra, rs, q FROM EncounterFacid f has TarF TarFAv a AND ALSO has PsmF PsmFSv s AND ALSO round(a, 2) AS ra AND ALSO round(s, 2) AS rs AND ALSO THE MINIMUM x IN (EncounterFacid y has TarF TarFAv x AND ALSO has Rk RkTa r WHERE r <= (THE COUNT OF xn IN (EncounterFacid fn has TarF TarFAv xn AND ALSO has PsmF PsmFSv yn) + 1) / 2) AS mt AND ALSO THE MINIMUM z IN (EncounterFacid w has PsmF PsmFSv z AND ALSO has sa RkSa r2 WHERE r2 <= (THE COUNT OF xn IN (EncounterFacid fn has TarF TarFAv xn AND ALSO has PsmF PsmFSv yn) + 1) / 2) AS ms AND ALSO if(a >= mt AND s >= ms, 'High Adherence, High Stability', if(a >= mt, 'High Adherence, Low Stability', if(s >= ms, 'Low Adherence, High Stability', 'Low Adherence, Low Stability'))) AS q ORDERED WITH q ASCENDING, f ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE TesP ::= LIST p, tv FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter has Patient p AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicTherapyDetails d AND ALSO if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'High', 3.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Medium', 2.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Low', 1.0, 0.0))) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY p AS tv LIST pk, ak, tm, rt, es, li FROM Encounter has Patient pt AND ALSO pt has PatientPatkey pk AND ALSO pt has TesP TesPTv tv AND ALSO has Assessmentbasic ab AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicAbkey ak AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicSuicrisk sr AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicMentalHealthScores ms AND ALSO has EncounterTimeMark tm AND ALSO has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO castNumber(jsonPath(ms, '$.depression.phq9_score')) AS ph AND ALSO castNumber(jsonPath(ms, '$.anxiety.gad7_score')) AS ga AND ALSO round(tv) AS rt AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM e IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityEnvstress e) AS es AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM l IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilityLifeimpact l) AS li WHERE (es = 'Severe' OR li = 'Severe') AND (sr = 'High' OR sr = 'Severe' OR ph > 15 OR ga > 15) AND tv < 2 ORDERED WITH tm DESCENDING THE FIRST 50

DEFINE MarP ::= LIST p, mv FROM Encounter has Patient p AND ALSO has EncounterMissappt m AND ALSO THE AVERAGE m GROUPED BY p AS mv DEFINE AssP ::= LIST p, sv, sc FROM Assessmentbasic has Patient p AND ALSO has AssessmentbasicSocsup ss AND ALSO has AssessmentbasicRelqual rq AND ALSO has AssessmentbasicRecstatus r AND ALSO (if(ss = 'Strong', 3.0, if(ss = 'Moderate', 2.0, 1.0)) + if(rq = 'Good', 3.0, if(rq = 'Fair', 2.0, if(rq = 'Poor', 1.0, 0.0)))) AS v AND ALSO if(r = 'Stable', 1, 0) AS w AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY p AS sv AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM w GROUPED BY p AS sc DEFINE FivP ::= LIST p, fc FROM Treatmentoutcome has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has Patient p AND ALSO has TreatmentoutcomeFuncimpv i AND ALSO if(i = 'Moderate' OR i = 'Significant', 1, 0) AS v AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM v GROUPED BY p AS fc LIST pk, mv, sv FROM Patient has PatientPatkey pk AND ALSO has MarP MarPMv mv AND ALSO has AssP AssPSv sv AND ALSO has sc AssPSc sc AND ALSO has FivP FivPFc fc WHERE sc = 1 AND fc = 1 AND (mv > 2 OR sv < 3)

DEFINE CriD ::= LIST d, cv FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicPrimdx d AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicCrisisint c AND ALSO THE SUM OF c GROUPED BY d AS cv DEFINE PatD ::= LIST d, pv FROM Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicPrimdx d AND ALSO has Patient has PatientPatkey p AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p GROUPED BY d AS pv LIST d, n, rc FROM AssessmentbasicPrimdx d has CriD CriDCv s AND ALSO has PatD PatDPv n AND ALSO (s / n) AS cif AND ALSO round(s / n, 2) AS rc ORDERED WITH cif DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE CriC ::= LIST c, cv FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterClinid c AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicCrisisint x AND ALSO THE SUM OF x GROUPED BY c AS cv DEFINE EncC ::= LIST c, mv, pv FROM Encounter has EncounterClinid c AND ALSO has EncounterMissappt m AND ALSO has Patient has PatientPatkey p AND ALSO THE SUM OF m GROUPED BY c AS mv AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p GROUPED BY c AS pv LIST c, fk, rp, rk FROM EncounterClinid c has CriC CriCCv x AND ALSO has EncC EncCMv m AND ALSO has pv EncCPv n AND ALSO (1.0 / (1.0 + x / n + m / n)) AS psm AND ALSO round(1.0 / (1.0 + x / n + m / n), 2) AS rp AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM k IN (Clinician [has ClinicianClinkey: !c] has Facility has FacilityFackey k) AS fk AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM v IN (Clinician [has ClinicianClinkey: !c] has Facility has FacilitySupportAndResources s AND ALSO if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Comprehensive', 3.0, if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Adequate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS v) AS rs AND ALSO THE RANK OF psm WITHIN fk AS rk WHERE rs >= 2 ORDERED WITH fk ASCENDING, rk ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE Chg ::= LIST tb, ct, cs, ps FROM Treatmentbasic tb has TreatmentbasicTherapyDetails d AND ALSO jsonPath(d, '$.changes') AS ct AND ALSO if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'High', 3.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Medium', 2.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Low', 1.0, 0.0))) AS cs AND ALSO tb has Encounter has EncounterTimeMark tm AND ALSO 1 AS g AND ALSO THE PREVIOUS cs BY tm WITHIN g AS ps LIST ct, n, rb, ra, rc FROM Treatmentbasic t has Chg ChgCt ct AND ALSO has cs ChgCs c2 AND ALSO has ps ChgPs p2 AND ALSO (c2 - p2) AS df AND ALSO THE COUNT OF t GROUPED BY ct AS n AND ALSO THE AVERAGE p2 GROUPED BY ct AS ab AND ALSO THE AVERAGE c2 GROUPED BY ct AS aa AND ALSO THE AVERAGE df GROUPED BY ct AS ac AND ALSO round(ab, 2) AS rb AND ALSO round(aa, 2) AS ra AND ALSO round(ac, 2) AS rc ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING

DEFINE TesF ::= LIST f, tv FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicTherapyDetails d AND ALSO if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'High', 3.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Medium', 2.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Low', 1.0, 0.0))) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS tv DEFINE OutF ::= LIST f, av, iv FROM Treatmentoutcome has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO has TreatmentoutcomeFuncimpv i AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS v AND ALSO if(i = 'Significant', 3.0, if(i = 'Moderate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS w AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS av AND ALSO THE AVERAGE w GROUPED BY f AS iv LIST f, rt, rr FROM EncounterFacid f has TesF TesFTv t AND ALSO has OutF OutFAv a AND ALSO has iv OutFIv i AND ALSO (i * a) AS rti AND ALSO round(t, 2) AS rt AND ALSO round(i * a, 2) AS rr WHERE t > 2.0 AND rti < 0.8 ORDERED WITH f ASCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE FacA ::= LIST f, sv, pv FROM Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has Assessmentbasic ab AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicSuicrisk r AND ALSO ab has AssessmentbasicFuncimp i AND ALSO if(r = 'High' OR r = 'Severe', 100.0, 0.0) AS a AND ALSO if(i = 'Severe', 3.0, if(i = 'Moderate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS b AND ALSO THE AVERAGE a GROUPED BY f AS sv AND ALSO THE AVERAGE b GROUPED BY f AS pv DEFINE FraF ::= LIST f, fv FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM v IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilitySupportAndResources s AND ALSO if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Comprehensive', 3.0, if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Adequate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS v) AS fv LIST f, p, r, d FROM EncounterFacid f has FacA FacASv sp AND ALSO has pv FacAPv p AND ALSO has FraF FraFFv r AND ALSO (p - r) AS d WHERE sp > 20 ORDERED WITH d DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE EncF ::= LIST f, pv, mv, pi FROM Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has Patient has PatientPatkey p AND ALSO has EncounterMissappt m AND ALSO has Assessmentbasic has AssessmentbasicFuncimp i AND ALSO if(i = 'Severe', 3.0, if(i = 'Moderate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS v AND ALSO THE DISTINCT COUNT OF p GROUPED BY f AS pv AND ALSO THE SUM OF m GROUPED BY f AS mv AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS pi DEFINE TesF ::= LIST f, tv FROM Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentbasicTherapyDetails d AND ALSO if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'High', 3.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Medium', 2.0, if(jsonPath(d, '$.engagement') = 'Low', 1.0, 0.0))) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS tv DEFINE TarF ::= LIST f, av FROM Treatmentoutcome has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS av DEFINE FraF ::= LIST f, fv FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM v IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilitySupportAndResources s AND ALSO if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Comprehensive', 3.0, if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Adequate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS v) AS fv LIST f, rd FROM EncounterFacid f has EncF EncFPv n AND ALSO has mv EncFMv m AND ALSO has pi EncFPi p AND ALSO has FraF FraFFv r AND ALSO has TesF TesFTv t AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv a AND ALSO (p - r) AS d AND ALSO ((t + a * 3.0) / 2.0) AS eas AND ALSO (m / n) AS mar AND ALSO round(p - r, 2) AS rd WHERE d > 1.0 AND eas < 1.5 AND mar > 2.5 ORDERED WITH d DESCENDING THE FIRST 100

DEFINE FraF ::= LIST f, fv FROM DISTINCT Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO THE MAXIMUM v IN (Facility [has FacilityFackey: !f] has FacilitySupportAndResources s AND ALSO if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Comprehensive', 3.0, if(jsonPath(s, '$.community_resources') = 'Adequate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS v) AS fv DEFINE TarF ::= LIST f, av FROM Treatmentoutcome has Treatmentbasic has Encounter has EncounterFacid f AND ALSO has TreatmentoutcomeTxadh a AND ALSO if(a = 'High' OR a = 'Medium', 1.0, 0.0) AS v AND ALSO THE AVERAGE v GROUPED BY f AS av LIST THE AVERAGE w IN (Facility has FacilitySupportAndResources r AND ALSO if(jsonPath(r, '$.community_resources') = 'Comprehensive', 3.0, if(jsonPath(r, '$.community_resources') = 'Adequate', 2.0, 1.0)) AS w), (THE SUM OF v1 IN (EncounterFacid f1 has FraF FraFFv x1 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y1 AND ALSO (x1 * y1) AS v1) - THE COUNT OF x2 IN (EncounterFacid f2 has FraF FraFFv x2 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y2) * THE AVERAGE x3 IN (EncounterFacid f3 has FraF FraFFv x3 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y3) * THE AVERAGE y4 IN (EncounterFacid f4 has FraF FraFFv x4 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y4)) / ((THE COUNT OF x5 IN (EncounterFacid f5 has FraF FraFFv x5 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y5) - 1) * THE STANDARD DEVIATION OF x6 IN (EncounterFacid f6 has FraF FraFFv x6 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y6) * THE STANDARD DEVIATION OF z7 IN (EncounterFacid f7 has FraF FraFFv x7 AND ALSO has TarF TarFAv y7 AND ALSO (y7 * 1.0) AS z7))
